CustomField.description: Sets what a Likert Matrix section collects and where its answer columns come from. Picklist: the rows are picklist fields and the columns are the first field's options, with any custom option labels and hidden options applied. Number: the rows are number fields and the columns come from the scale in Likert Scale, each saving the number mapped to it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose what kind of fields this matrix collects. Picklist builds the answer columns from your picklist's option labels and stores the option values; Number lets you define your own labeled scale where each column saves a number you map to it.
CustomField.label: Likert Mode
